notes.title: The Tutorial Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, all! It has been quite a while since I have put out anything for this game, but here I am, releasing a semi-major update. The main [u][i][b]juiciness[/b][/i][/u] of this is a fully fledged out tutorial! When starting the game up for the first time, you will be shoved into a tutorial (you can exit at any time), which will hopefully help with that initial frustration many have had. If you have any notes or comments, please feel free to reach out! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38834572/81604a972adf4581ee6b3777ce79256109412358.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38834572/c6d4ef4ab350b690a56e6f31afd6073beb0fe427.png[/img]

In addition to the tutorial and its integration into the rest of the game, I also have created a music player, so you can jam out to some great (DMCA free) tunes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38834572/6445a8f14963ab56cbd4b70a235eafcb22efa9d5.gif[/img]

Other than that, I have made improvements to the existing levels, making some parts easier, harder, or just redoing some parts altogether! I feel these will help make the game more fun and look more appealing, as some parts may have been annoying difficult, rather than fun difficult, or just looked plain boring and drab. These changes were made with strategic thought and with the player's best interest in mind, so if you, as a player, don't feel it represents you, feel free to reach out and voice your concerns! 

Thanks to anyone that has stuck around or even attempted this project. I hope these changes will keep ya playing!

I am planning on definitely doing a few more major updates, with some being racing with multiplayer, arcade mode (similar to super monkey ball), and a sandbox. I have a lot of ideas, but it just takes a while as a one man team, so thank you for your patience!

Take care, and thanks for your support,
- GNos Games
